Joe Rogan tells how Kid Rock punched a man at Bohemian Grove in a segment from his show. Bohemian Grove is the private woods camp where rich and strong men of the US meet each year. Kid Rock is a rock and rap star from Detroit.

Rogan shares the tale as it was told to him, with the drinks, the woods, and the fist all in place. He uses it to muse on the odd mix of power and play at the Grove. The segment is short and told for laughs. Listeners get a bar-room tale from a famed camp. The library holds the file as an archive record of the story as told.
